reviewNotes: HOLD. Visible base prepaid plan remains current at USD25/month or USD275/year on Verizon, with a provider-defined 60-day nonpayment suspension window before cancellation/reassignment. Visible officially supports Wi-Fi Calling abroad but requires it to be activated before leaving the U.S.; Global Pass is available for international cellular use. Current independent/provider-moderated evidence confirms long-duration Wi-Fi Calling abroad, while eSIM activation outside the U.S. remains contradictory. Foreign-issued payment execution is also unresolved, so keep the route normalized as HOLD rather than promote it as a China-first acquisition route.

events.outcome: Visible base remains USD25/month or USD275/year. Current terms suspend nonpayment-deactivated service for 60 days before cancellation/reassignment. Official Wi-Fi Calling works internationally when enabled before leaving the U.S.; current independent evidence corroborates long-duration use abroad, while overseas first activation remains contradictory.

data.acquisitionSummary: Visible base prepaid plan remains available on Verizon at USD25/month, with an annual option at USD275/year including taxes and fees. Physical SIM and eSIM paths are supported for compatible devices.

keep.action: Use the USD275 annual base plan for the lowest current full-year listed cost, or keep the USD25 monthly plan paid. Visible terms say a nonpayment-deactivated account is suspended for 60 days and then cancelled/reassigned if payment is not made; treat that 60-day period as recovery only.

data.chinaActivation: Current Visible official material does not establish a China-first paid-account activation path. A provider representative previously said overseas eSIM activation can work over stable Wi-Fi, while the same thread contains a user report that the app required U.S. presence. Preserve the conflict rather than promise remote activation.
data.kyc: Visible is prepaid. The reviewed current provider pages do not establish a separate foreign-subscriber identity-verification path.
data.payment: Visible requires a valid payment method and supports card/PayPal account billing. Reliable foreign-issued-card execution is not established in this review.
data.wifiCalling: Visible officially supports Wi-Fi Calling outside the U.S., but the feature must be activated before leaving the U.S. Current April 2026 community evidence reports four continuous months abroad with Wi-Fi Calling functioning after U.S. setup.
data.roamingSms: The base plan can use Global Pass in more than 140 countries, generally USD10/day outside Canada/Mexico/PR/USVI, with unlimited talk/text and data allowance. For cheaper long-term overseas use, current provider/community evidence supports calls/SMS over pre-enabled Wi-Fi Calling; third-party OTP reliability remains service-specific.
data.holdReason: Paid-account/eSIM activation outside the U.S. remains contradictory, foreign-issued payment reliability is unresolved, and Wi-Fi Calling must be set up before leaving the U.S.; do not present this as a dependable China-first route.
data.tariffSummary: Visible base: USD25/month or USD275/year. Nonpayment has a 60-day suspended recovery window before cancellation. Wi-Fi Calling works abroad if activated before departure; Global Pass is available.
guideSteps: Acquire and activate through a supported U.S. path; do not assume overseas first activation.
Enable and test Wi-Fi Calling before leaving the U.S.
Keep annual/monthly service paid; use the 60-day nonpayment window only as recovery, not as a maintenance strategy.
